# glm.matrix.fit_glm_from_matrix { #fmrimod.glm.matrix.fit_glm_from_matrix }

```python
fit_glm_from_matrix(
    X,
    Y,
    model=None,
    cfg=None,
    strategy='external',
    engine='runwise',
)
```

Fit a matrix-design GLM and return a full ``FmriLm`` result.

Unlike `fit_glm_from_suffstats`, this path keeps raw ``X`` and ``Y``
available to the solver, so cancellation-prone RSS values can be recovered
from explicit residuals.
